stories.title: ODOT says highway fund revenues are verifiably on the decline, pinching state and local transportation budgets
stories.summary: When ODOT first began sounding the alarm a few years back, fuel tax revenue was only slowing in growth. Now, they say, revenues are actually down year-over-year.

stories.title: 'We're all hurting': Mother of man killed along Eastbank Esplanade pleads for the public's help
stories.summary: Colton Mincey, 35, was fatally shot on Portland's Eastbank Esplanade on Aug. 26. His family is still waiting for answers.

stories.title: Berkly Catton scores a hat trick as the Kraken beat the Canucks 5-1
stories.summary: Berkly Catton got his first NHL hat trick, helping the Seattle Kraken end a three-game losing streak with a 5-1 victory over the Vancouver Canucks.

stories.title: King tides return to the Oregon Coast next week
stories.summary: Visitors have the chance to catch the high tides from Sunday, Nov. 23, to Thursday, Nov. 27.

stories.title: Oregon flags will be lowered to half-staff in honor of fire chief
stories.summary: Oregon flags will be lowered in honor of George Martin, fire chief of the Adrian Rural Fire District, who died on Nov. 7.

stories.title: More than 100K Washington girls face new sex verification rule to play school sports
stories.summary: A new requirement for girls playing school sports takes effect Dec. 3, the same day a judge will hear arguments over whether to block the law.

stories.title: Multnomah County to begin enforcing flavored tobacco ban next year after court approval
stories.summary: A ban on flavored nicotine and tobacco products starts in Multnomah County in January. The ban will be phased in until 2028, when full enforcement begins.

stories.title: Oregon food pantries tighten their belts as Trump administration considers further SNAP restrictions
stories.summary: Some 70,000 Oregonians lost food benefits under the "Big Beautiful Bill," but the Trump administration wants to further tighten eligibility.

stories.title: $elling $kinny: An inside look at the year-long investigation into GLP-1s
stories.summary: Unlicensed workers. A warehouse raid. Overdoses. KING 5's year-long investigation into GLP-1s exposes a Washington pharmacy at the center of it all.

stories.title: Employee with Scappoose School District charged with child luring, sexual corruption
stories.summary: David Nelson III was arrested after a nearly month-long investigation by the Scappoose Police Department and has been placed on administrative leave.

stories.title: Oregon confirms first human case of bird flu this year
stories.summary: The person, whose identity wasn't released, was successfully treated and didn't need to be hospitalized, OHA officials said.

stories.title: Multnomah County DA wants Oregon law changed to allow felony charges in serious dog attacks
stories.summary: A Portland woman lost an arm and an ear after being mauled by eight dogs. Her case is prompting the Multnomah County district attorney to push for tougher penalties.
